text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

A panel's composition is not evidence of bias. Four women on a panel is unremarkable and says nothing about how they weighed candidates — just as an all-male panel wouldn't prove bias against a woman. Raising it would make you look aggrieved and undermine any legitimate point you have.

Your actual grievance is procedural: a two-week silence on a reasonable request for written feedback. Chase that, politely and in writing, to HR.

Also weigh the possibility the decision was defensible. "Excellent client relationships" is not filler in consultancy — group heads sell work and manage clients. Fifteen years of design depth doesn't automatically beat eight years plus commercial strength.

If feedback reveals something concrete, reassess then.
